scripts.deploy: bun run --filter web build && alchemy deploy
scripts.verify:worker-bundles: cd ../../apps/web && if find ../server/dist dist -name '*.map' -print -quit | grep -q .; then echo 'Source maps remain in Worker deployment artifacts.' >&2; exit 1; fi && ./node_modules/.bin/wrangler deploy --dry-run --config dist/server/wrangler.json && ./node_modules/.bin/wrangler deploy ../server/dist/index.mjs --dry-run --no-bundle --name grabbin-server-module-check --compatibility-date "$(date -u +%F)" --compatibility-flags nodejs_compat
scripts.deploy:production: NODE_ENV=production SENTRY_UPLOAD_SOURCE_MAPS=1 bun --env-file=../../apps/web/.env.production --env-file=../../apps/server/.env.production run --filter web build && NODE_ENV=production SENTRY_UPLOAD_SOURCE_MAPS=1 bun --env-file=../../apps/web/.env.production --env-file=../../apps/server/.env.production run --filter server build && bun run verify:worker-bundles && NODE_ENV=production SENTRY_UPLOAD_SOURCE_MAPS=1 bun --env-file=../../apps/web/.env.production --env-file=../../apps/server/.env.production run alchemy deploy --stage production
